result.summary: Replaces shell append operators (`>>`) with file overwrite operators (`>`) when saving PSBT data in `doc/offline-signing-tutorial.md`. This prevents duplicate lines from accumulating if the command is executed multiple times, which would otherwise cause downstream commands using `$(cat ...)` to fail with argument errors.
result.problem: Users following the offline signing tutorial who re-run the `send` or `walletprocesspsbt` step without deleting the output files end up with multi-line PSBT files that break subsequent CLI commands.

result.card: This PR changes shell redirection from append (`>>`) to overwrite (`>`) in `doc/offline-signing-tutorial.md` when exporting PSBTs. It prevents downstream shell commands from failing with argument count errors if a user repeats a step without deleting intermediate files. The change is trivial (+2/-2) and has seen an AI-policy objection resolved by the author, but has not yet received a technical review.
